paper: EFS: Evolutionary Factor Searching for Sparse Portfolio Optimization Using Large Language Models
headline_agent: LLM-guided evolutionary factor search followed by factor scoring and sparse portfolio optimization
headline_component: Table VI US50 skew-gated breakout factor
component_selection_reason: This is the only disclosed example formula explicitly labeled for a U.S. stock universe (US50). It is selected by paper market scope, not by its already-observed JKP performance; the CSI300 and HSI45 formulas are not searched for a better outcome.
source_scope: one disclosed U.S. example factor, not the evolutionary search, Scores-to-Weights/RW step, or final sparse portfolio

monthly_adapter.inputs: JKP monthly abs(prc) and ret in the formation-date top-1,000 U.S. universe
monthly_adapter.operators: source tree with sample rolling std, linear decay weights 1..n, conditional skew volatility gate, and monthly population cs_zscore
monthly_adapter.portfolio: researcher top-10 equal-weight long-only score portfolio
monthly_adapter.costs: common fixed cost cases with 10 bp primary
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: fixed holdings re-accounted under common zero and adverse-100 policies without reranking

adapted: daily US50 bars to monthly top-1,000 U.S. JKP bars
